items.source: This level includes the prohibitions in REPEATABLE_READ and further prohibits the situation where one transaction reads all rows that satisfy a WHERE condition, a second transaction inserts a row that satisfies that WHERE condition, and the first transaction re-reads for the same condition, retrieving the additional "phantom" row in the second read.
items.translation: 该级别包含REPEATABLE_READ中的禁止项，并进一步禁止以下情况：一个事务读取所有满足某个WHERE条件的行，另一个事务插入一行满足该WHERE条件，然后第一个事务再次针对相同条件进行读取，从而在第二次读取中检索到额外的“幻象”行。

items.source:
This level allows a row changed by one transaction to be read by
another transaction before any changes in that row have been committed
(a "dirty read"). If any of the changes are rolled back, the second
transaction will have retrieved an invalid row.
items.translation: 该级别允许一个事务修改的行在提交之前被另一个事务读取（即“脏读”）。如果任何更改被回滚，第二个事务将获取到无效的行。

items.source: Enumeration that represents transaction isolation levels for use with the @Transactional annotation, corresponding to the TransactionDefinition interface.
items.translation: 表示事务隔离级别并可与 @Transactional 注解一起使用的枚举，对应于 TransactionDefinition 接口。

items.source:

the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source: All other levels correspond to the JDBC isolation levels.
items.translation: 所有其他级别均对应于 JDBC 隔离级别。

items.source:
This level only prohibits a transaction from reading a row with uncommitted
changes in it.
items.translation: 此级别仅禁止事务读取包含未提交更改的行。

items.source:
This level prohibits a transaction from reading a row with uncommitted changes
in it, and it also prohibits the situation where one transaction reads a row,
a second transaction alters the row, and the first transaction re-reads the row,
getting different values the second time (a "non-repeatable read").
items.translation: 该级别禁止事务读取包含未提交更改的行，同时也禁止以下情况：一个事务读取某行后，第二个事务修改了该行，而第一个事务再次读取该行时得到了不同的值（即“不可重复读”）。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Use the default isolation level of the underlying data store.
items.translation: 使用底层数据存储的默认隔离级别。

items.source:
A constant indicating that dirty reads are prevented; non-repeatable reads
and phantom reads can occur.
items.translation: 一个常量，表示防止脏读；但可能发生不可重复读和幻读。

items.source:
A constant indicating that dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads
can occur.
items.translation: 指示可能发生脏读、不可重复读和幻读的常量。

items.source:
A constant indicating that dirty reads and non-repeatable reads are
prevented; phantom reads can occur.
items.translation: 一个常量，表示防止脏读和不可重复读；幻读可能发生。

items.source:
A constant indicating that dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom
reads are prevented.
items.translation: 一个指示防止脏读、不可重复读和幻读的常量。
